stalls.Fruit: Fresh from the Secret Gardens! Fruit makes you feel brand new.
stalls.Sweets: Sweet treats for sweet people. One at a time, mind!
stalls.Crystals: Shiny things that catch the light.
stalls.Flowers: Bramble grew every one of these.
stalls.Records: Music for your ears and stickers for your sash.
stalls.Boutique: Head to toe and everything in between. Try it on!
stalls.Gadget: Dash's gadgets! He builds them from bits of broken time. Nothing gets hurt: they pop, fizz and dance.
stalls.Tune-Up: Zippy's Tune-Up! Every upgrade works on every ride: your board and your friends' rides too. Vroom!
stalls.Bakery: Crumb & Cauldron Bakery! Baked fresh this morning. The cauldron cakes are green inside, for Halloween.
stalls.Toy Shop: Gizmo & Gumdrop Toys! Hats for Halloween, and anything that spins.
stalls.Diner: Hollow Diner. Sit down, eat up, don't complain about the coffee. (Gus)
stalls.Corner Market: The Corner Market: apples, candy and fizzy pop. Kip's on the till. Probably.
stalls.Festival Treats: Poppy's festival treats: warm, sweet and very sticky!
stalls.Cider Cart: Gus's Cider Cart. Hot cider, cold cider, and one secret donut.
